company.name: Privacera
company.shortDescription: Privacera is a SaaS-based data security and governance platform that offers data sharing without compromising regulatory compliance.
company.description:
Privacera is a SaaS data security and governance platform that enable data sharing without compromising regulatory compliance.

It provides security for sensitive data across multiple cloud services such as AWS, Azure, Databricks, GCP, and Snowflake. The platform is utilized by Fortune 500 customers across finance, insurance, retail, media, and consumer industries to automate sensitive data discovery and easily manage high-fidelity policy management at a petabyte-scale on-prem and in the cloud. Privacera's backer includes Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, Battery Ventures, Accel, Cervin Ventures, and Point 72 Ventures.

The San Francisco, California-headquartered company was established in 2016 by Balaji Ganesan and Don Bosco Durai.
